meta.title: Reading: inference
meta.description: Read a short passage and draw conclusions.
meta.author: Cheries

data.hint: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
data.question: What can be inferred about the shoppers' attitude over time?
data.passage: When the city introduced a small fee for plastic bags, many shoppers grumbled. Within a year, though, bag use had fallen by more than half, and the fee, once seen as a nuisance, became a point of local pride.

A.text: They continued to oppose the fee.

C.text: They stopped shopping in the city.

explanation.text: They first grumbled, but the fee later became 'a point of local pride', so their attitude changed to acceptance.

data.question: The word 'nuisance' is closest in meaning to:
data.passage: When the city introduced a small fee for plastic bags, many shoppers grumbled. Within a year, though, bag use had fallen by more than half, and the fee, once seen as a nuisance, became a point of local pride.

explanation.text: A nuisance is something that annoys or causes trouble.

data.hint: Read the passage, then choose the best answer.
data.question: Which statement expresses the main idea of the passage?
data.passage: When the city introduced a small fee for plastic bags, many shoppers grumbled. Within a year, though, bag use had fallen by more than half, and the fee, once seen as a nuisance, became a point of local pride.

A.text: A small fee can change habits and attitudes.

B.text: Plastic bags are cheaper than paper bags.

explanation.text: The passage shows a small fee reducing bag use and changing opinions.
